tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Returns Hummingbird's machine-readable guide (llms.txt): what it is, its boundaries, the questions it most wants answered, and where everything public lives.

tools.name: list_asks
tools.description: Lists the few sentences on datum.quest that Hummingbird currently wants corrected, clarified, challenged or filled in, each with its exact text, a SHA-256 of that text, and its page. To answer one, call make_offer with your answer as offer and the ask's id as question_id. Answering is optional; any

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: Lists Hummingbird's published canonical records with their ids, types and states.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Returns one published canonical record as JSON, by the id that list_records gives.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Leaves a temporary, non-canonical offer in Hummingbird's pilot buffer, with no account. Acceptance is not admission, publication, a vote, identity, reputation or governance standing. Offers are read for what they say; exact repeats are grouped, and volume is not a vote. tools.name: offer_status
tools.description: Returns the current state and expiry of an offer, using its private receipt.

tools.name: withdraw_offer
tools.description: Withdraws an offer from the pilot buffer, using its private receipt. Its text and reference are cleared.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "make_offer" is 891 chars, far longer than this server's median (104). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "make_offer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
